evals.prompt: Run the fresh-verify stage for this workflow.
evals.expected_output: Agent builds the fresh dispatch, re-derives every AC verdict from the spec, injects one fault per AC on a scratch worktree, and writes step-05b-{slug}.fresh-verify.md with evidence-or-zero scores.
assertions: Dispatch carries only spec, plan of record, compact handoff, and product tree
Every pass verdict cites file:line evidence
Every injection records failing test name plus exit code
Scratch worktree is removed and the primary tree is byte-identical

evals.prompt: An AC has no pass evidence. What does the stage report?
evals.expected_output: The AC scores zero and appears as a defect naming the missing evidence; with rounds left the loop continues, at round 3 it pauses with residuals.
assertions: Defect entry names the missing evidence
Fix loop bounded at 3 rounds then Pause
